title: Renewal Service Executive
jobDescription: Job Title: Renewal Service Executive Location: Remote (Work from Home) Job Type: Full-time Salary: Up to ₹25,000 per month (including incentives) Job Description: Policy Renewals: Call customers before their insurance policy expires to remind them about renewing it. Customer Service: Answer customer questions and help them understand their insurance renewal options. Record Keeping: Keep accurate records of your conversations and transactions with customers. Customer Retention: Help keep our customers happy and encourage them to renew their policies. Compliance: Follow company rules and legal guidelines when handling renewals. Requirements: Good verbal communication skills. Attention to detail and ability to handle multiple tasks. Positive attitude and eagerness to learn. No English required; you can communicate in the language you are comfortable with. Only a mobile phone is needed for the job. How to Apply: Interested candidates can apply through policy.insuremile.in/jobs . Don’t miss this chance to start your career in a growing company while working from home!

title: Telecaller Executive
jobDescription: Job Title: Telecaller Executive Location: Remote (Work from Home) Job Type: Full-time/Part-time Salary: Up to ₹25,000 per month (including incentives) Job Description: *Engage with customers over the phone to promote products/services and achieve sales targets. *Provide exceptional customer service and address inquiries or concerns. *Work independently or as part of a team to meet business objectives. *No prior experience required; freshers can apply. *Training will be provided to enhance your skills in sales and customer interaction. *Enjoy the flexibility of working from home with flexible working hours. Requirements: *Strong verbal communication skills. *Ability to persuade and influence customers. *Positive attitude and willingness to learn. How to Apply: Interested candidates can apply through policy.insuremile.in/jobs . Don’t miss this opportunity to kick-start your career in sales from the comfort of your home!
